title: Drop stale gate evidence when a new verdict carries none
instrument: vitest on applyVerdict with a seeded artifact holding evidence, then a verdict without evidence: assert readEvidence() === null
body:
## Summary
applyVerdict keeps the PREVIOUS verdict's data.evidence when the new verdict has no evidence, so a fresh pass/fail is audited against an older run's proof.

## Description
src/lib/test-gate-runner/drain.ts:144 `const data = verdict.evidence ? { ...prevData, evidence: verdict.evidence } : prevData;` — prevData already holds the last run's evidence. evidenceAudit.readEvidence (src/lib/test-gate-runner/evidenceAudit.ts:24) then reports the new status beside the old proof, and the row never lands in `missing`. Tiers of Truth: evidence binds to the run that produced it (registry software-engineering/proof-carrying-agent-actions, technique evidence-binds-to-the-measured-change). Fixed = a verdict without evidence deletes data.evidence (or stamps `{kind, at, markers:["no evidence"]}`) so the audit lists it as missing. drain.ts is in no context-map context, outside this round's paths.

## Flow
- gate drained once with evidence {kind:scenario, stats}
- a later producer applies {status:pass, detail} with no evidence (settleGatesFromTestRun or any future executor)
- artifact shows pass + the earlier run's stats; audit counts it evidenced

## Expected impact
The judge fleet / pof_gate_evidence stop reading a stale proof under a new verdict. Could break: nothing today — all 6 current producers attach evidence (grep of GateEvidence literals), so the path is latent.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a verdict is never paired with another run's evidence
Before: simulation: 1 merge site keeps prevData.evidence; 0 tests cover a verdict without evidence over prior evidence
After: predicted: the audit reports such a row under missing; test asserts data.evidence absent
Method: simulation - fix site outside this round's declared paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Make evidence required on a pass/fail GateVerdict
instrument: npm run typecheck after the union change; count of compile errors = producers/fixtures to fix
body:
## Summary
GateVerdict.evidence is optional for every status, so the type can represent a claimed pass with no observation at all.

## Description
src/lib/test-gate-runner/types.ts:83-101 declares `status: pass|fail|deferred` and `evidence?: GateEvidence`. The project rule (Tiers of Truth: no done without a ground-truth observation) is enforced only by convention: all 6 producers (batchAutomation.ts:130,179, bridgeExecutor.ts:139, spawnExecutor.ts:285,316, visualExecutor.ts:81-123) happen to attach it. Fixed = a discriminated union where pass/fail require evidence and deferred may omit it; the compiler then refuses a proofless pass. Touches types.ts + producers (another area) -> M, B.

## Flow
- split GateVerdict into {status:deferred, evidence?} | {status:pass|fail, evidence}
- fix every producer the compiler names
- typecheck green

## Expected impact
A future executor cannot land a pass without proof. Could break: test fixtures that build bare verdicts.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a pass without evidence is unrepresentable
Before: 0 of 3 statuses require evidence; 6/6 producers attach it by convention
After: predicted 2 of 3 require it; typecheck is the gate
Method: simulation - cross-context type change not owned by this round
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Count proof-less GateEvidence as missing in the evidence audit
instrument: vitest on buildEvidenceAudit with one artifact whose evidence is {kind,at}: expect missing.length 1
body:
## Summary
readEvidence accepts {kind, at} with no markers, samples, stats, screenshot or judge text, so a verdict with an empty proof reads as audited.

## Description
src/types/observation.ts:282-298 makes every proof field optional; src/lib/test-gate-runner/evidenceAudit.ts:24-31 checks only kind + at. summarizeEvidence (src/types/observation.ts:317-326) then renders just "[visual]". Fixed = a pure hasProof(e) in observation.ts (at least one non-empty proof field) used by buildEvidenceAudit to route empty evidence into `missing`.

## Flow
- artifact data.evidence = {kind:"visual", at:"..."}
- GET /api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/evidence lists it under rows, not missing
- add hasProof + route to missing

## Expected impact
The audit stops crediting an empty proof. Could break: none of the 6 producers emits an empty evidence today.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - only evidence with proof counts as audited
Before: simulation: 1 shape check (kind+at) admits 0-field evidence
After: predicted: empty evidence lands in missing; test asserts
Method: simulation - evidenceAudit.ts is outside this round's paths (the predicate half is in-path)
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Make the drain GET queue refuse unparsed scope keys like POST does
body:
## Summary
GET /api/pipeline-artifacts/drain?tier=l3 or ?entityId= silently previews a wider queue than named, while POST with the same scope now 400s (d921ef2f).

## Description
src/app/api/pipeline-artifacts/drain/route.ts GET passes searchParams through parseDrainFilter, which drops unparsed values. The preview and the run now disagree: the batch previewed via GET is not the one POST accepts. Fixed = the same SCOPE_KEYS check on present-but-unparsed params.

## Flow
- GET ?catalogId=items&tier=l3 -> both tiers listed
- POST same scope -> 400
- apply SCOPE_KEYS check in GET

## Expected impact
Preview matches what POST will accept. Read-only path, so low stakes. Could break: a caller passing ?tier=all expecting everything.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - GET preview and POST accept the same scope
Before: GET: 0 of 4 scope keys refused when unparsed; POST: 4 of 4
After: predicted 4 of 4 on both
Method: simulation - not built this round (budget)
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Reject non-positive drain port and limit (posNum accepts negatives)
body:
## Summary
drainRequest posNum() accepts any finite number, so port:-1 reaches the bridge executor and limit:-5 runs nothing under a 200.

## Description
src/lib/test-gate-runner/drainRequest.ts posNum returns any finite value despite its name; parseDrainRequest forwards port/limit. limit<=0 makes drainAll skip every job (src/lib/test-gate-runner/drain.ts:251), reported as a successful empty drain. Fixed = posNum requires > 0 (and integer), else the route 400s naming the key.

## Flow
- POST {catalogId, limit:-5} -> 200 ran:0
- POST {port:-1} -> bridge probe to port -1, gates read unavailable

## Expected impact
A typo reads as a refusal, not as "nothing to drain". Could break: callers sending limit:0 to mean preview (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - out-of-range run options refused
Before: simulation: 2 keys accept negatives
After: predicted 0
Method: simulation - drainRequest.ts outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Validate the economy philosophy so the stamped config matches the run
instrument: normalize-config test: philosophy "xyz" -> a PHILOSOPHY_MODS key
body:
## Summary
normalizeSimulationConfig casts philosophy unchecked; an unknown value simulates as balanced but result.config (and the generated C++ header / saved run) still says the unknown value.

## Description
src/lib/economy/normalize-config.ts `philosophy: (cfg.philosophy as ...) ?? "loot-driven"`; src/lib/economy/simulation-engine.ts:99 falls back to PHILOSOPHY_MODS.balanced. So {philosophy:"xyz"} runs balanced while every output labels it xyz. Fixed = normalize to a known key (fallback loot-driven, the default) so label == mechanics.

## Flow
- POST simulate {config:{philosophy:"xyz"}}
- engine uses balanced mods; result.config.philosophy === "xyz"
- codegen header and saved runs say xyz

## Expected impact
Exported/saved configs describe what was simulated. Could break: nothing in the UI (select offers only valid keys).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - config label equals simulated mechanics
Before: simulation: 1 unvalidated enum field; label/mechanics disagree for every unknown value
After: predicted 0
Method: simulation - normalize-config.ts is outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Retire the unused non-streaming combat runSimulation and two API types
instrument: typecheck + combat store tests after removal
body:
## Summary
combatSimulatorStore.runSimulation has 0 production callers (the view uses runSimulationStreaming) and RunCombatSimRequest / GetCombatDefaultsResponse have 0 consumers.

## Description
grep `.runSimulation` for the combat store: only src/__tests__/stores/combatSimulatorStore.test.ts:88,104; the one UI caller is src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx:73 (runSimulationStreaming). grep RunCombatSimRequest|GetCombatDefaultsResponse outside src/types/combat-simulator.ts: 0 hits. The two run paths duplicate the baseline-compare + set block (src/stores/combatSimulatorStore.ts runSimulation vs runSimulationStreaming), and only the streaming one got the refusal-reason fix (207c9abc). Fixed = delete runSimulation (retarget its A/B tests to the streaming path) and the two types.

## Flow
- retarget the 2 store tests to runSimulationStreaming with a stubbed SSE body
- delete runSimulation + interface entry
- delete the 2 types; typecheck

## Expected impact
One run path to keep correct instead of two. Could break: an external caller of the store action (none in tree).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one combat run path
Before: 2 run implementations, 1 used; 2 zero-consumer types
After: predicted 1 and 0
Method: probe - zero-consumer greps taken; removal not built (needs test retargeting)
Result: better
Gate: none
